summary.title: Juice Shop Threat Model
summary.description: "The OWASP Juice Shop is a vulnerable web application designed to be used as a security training and testing platform. It simulates an online store where users can purchase items, and it contains various security flaws to learn from."

threats.title: Credential Stuffing & Brute Force
threats.description: Attackers try common or leaked passwords to gain unauthorized access.
threats.mitigation: Enforce account lockout policies and implement CAPTCHA.

threats.title: Session Hijacking
threats.description: Session tokens are not properly secured, allowing attackers to take over user sessions.
threats.mitigation: Use HTTP-only and secure cookies, enforce session expiration.

threats.title: Sensitive Data Exposure
threats.description: Credit card details and addresses are stored or transmitted insecurely.
threats.mitigation: Encrypt payment data using PCI-DSS standards, do not store CVV.

threats.title: Man-In-The-Middle Attack (MITM)
threats.description: Payment information intercepted due to lack of TLS encryption.
threats.mitigation: Enforce HTTPS with HSTS, use TLS 1.2 or higher.

threats.title: Price Manipulation
threats.description: Attackers modify cart prices using client-side scripts
threats.mitigation: Validate prices on the server-side, prevent client-side price overrides.

threats.title: Malicious File Upload
threats.description: Attackers upload malicious files (e.g., scripts, executables) through profile image upload.
threats.mitigation: Restrict file types, scan files for malware, store images in a separate server.

threats.title: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
threats.description: User-generated content (feedback, complaints) is not sanitized, leading to XSS.
threats.mitigation: Sanitize input using a secure HTML sanitizer, enforce Content Security Policy (CSP).

threats.title: SQL Injection
threats.description: Attackers inject malicious SQL queries through form inputs.
threats.mitigation: Use parameterized queries and ORM frameworks, avoid dynamic SQL queries.
